title: Application for Designation as an Institution Dedicated to Supporting Cultural and Artistic Activities of Artists with Disabilities
title_original: 장애예술인 문화예술 활동 지원 업무 전담기관 지정신청서
full_text:
Application for Designation as an Institution Dedicated to Supporting Cultural and Artistic Activities of Artists with Disabilities
Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Support for Cultural and Artistic Activities of Artists with Disabilities — Attached Form No. 2

Do not fill in shaded fields.
Receipt No.: ______ | Date and time received: ______ | Processing period: 30 days

Applicant
Institution name: ______
Business registration No. (unique identification No.): ______
Representative's name: ______ | Date of establishment: Year ____ Month ____ Day ____
Office address: ______
Telephone: ______

I hereby apply for designation as an institution dedicated to supporting cultural and artistic activities of artists with disabilities as stated above pursuant to Article 14(1) of the Act on the Support for Cultural and Artistic Activities of Artists with Disabilities, Article 7(2) of its Enforcement Decree, and Article 3(1) of its Enforcement Rules.

Year: ____ Month: ____ Day: ____
Applicant: ______ (signature or seal)
To: Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism

Documents to be submitted by the applicant
1. Articles of association
2. Business plan
3. Documents proving compliance with each requirement in Article 7(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Support for Cultural and Artistic Activities of Artists with Disabilities

Matter to be verified by the responsible public official: Certificate of registered corporate particulars
Fee: None

Processing procedure
1. Prepare application — Applicant
2. Receipt — Processing authority (Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism)
3. Review — Processing authority (Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism)
4. Designation — Processing authority (Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism)
5. Notification

210 mm × 297 mm [white paper (80 g/m²) or medium-grade paper (80 g/m²)]

metadata.self_review: AI full-text review against all three Korean form texts: all applicant fields, 60/30-day processing periods, recipients, exact Act/Decree/Rules references, attachments, official verification, no fee, five process stages, signatures/seals and paper specifications retained.
